fields.Participants: Ecommerce Dir, Legal, Finance, VP Marketing
fields.Trigger: Strategic decision to add marketplace channel

Automation Opportunity: - Process steps auto-sequenced with system controls; data-entry auto-populated from master data; exceptions auto-flagged for human review
Controls: - CTL-424 (ensure controlled execution — Marketplace Channel Onboarding & Configuration (PA-65.1).)
- operational: GM, Digital Commerce Inc. sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integration-failure risk**: marketplace API sync fails (catalog, inventory, or order), causing overselling or customer-facing errors; mitigated by real-time sync monitoring and the failover to manual processing

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce/marketplace platform (links to VS-10 / W11 BOPIS, W180 marketplace integration)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the GM, Digital Commerce Inc. role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.
